lines.text: Want to see your TF2 loadout before you spend a single cent?
This is SFMC Studio. It's free, and it runs right in your browser.
Pick any of the nine classes. No downloads. No imports.
Search every cosmetic in the game, and try it on in real 3D.
Every item shows its Steam Market price, right next to it.
Paint it, flip to BLU, and spin it around. Check every angle.
Here's what the whole look costs. Before you buy anything.
Love it? Send it to the editor, give your character a personality, and save it.
Then export a render and a full spec for Source Filmmaker. Or back up your entire library.
Your whole collection lives in the library. Search it, favorite it, and reopen any character in one click.
No account. No tracking. Your characters never leave your browser.
SFMC Studio. Free and open source, at sfmc-studio dot kori dot my.
